verdict.rationale: Skills hand repeatable tasks to Claude. Claude loads a skill automatically when relevant, or you invoke it directly with /skill-name, and bundled skills like /run and /verify work without setup (docs-2, docs-5, docs-25, gh-9). However, the assistant itself is Claude, the host the Skills format runs on, not something the Skills product provides. Users also report unreliable automatic triggering: Vercel's evals found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases, so delegation often requires explicit invocation (comm-12, comm-13, comm-14). missing for 10: an assistant that belongs to the product itself rather than the host, reliable automatic delegation, independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end task delegation.
